recipe.visualDefinition: A high-glamour portrait of a woman in 1920s flapper-inspired attire, framed by a complex, neon-pink Art Deco geometric border. The subject reclines on a dark velvet chaise, wearing a pearl-and-crystal headpiece and feather boa, set against a deep black background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered within a rigid geometric frame
Contrast between soft textures (feathers, velvet) and sharp linear graphics
Harmonious color link between the pink border and the subject's makeup and feathers
Symmetrical framing vs. asymmetrical reclining pose
coreInvariants: Multi-line Art Deco border with stepped corners
High-contrast studio lighting with soft skin tones

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, subject occupies the central 70% of the frame, reclining diagonally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the intricate jeweled headpiece.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top display text, move down the geometric border lines to the subject's face, then follow the reclining arm to the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black background surrounding the chaise and filling the corners behind the border.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black (background and hair) providing high contrast.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Luminous neon pink (border, lips, and feather tips).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright pearls/skin and the dark background; saturation is concentrated in the pink accents.

letterConstructionRules: Overlapping characters and nested letters (e.g., 'O' inside 'G')
Art Deco stylistic flourishes like elongated crossbars
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters like 'S' and 'G' feature exaggerated geometric curves
The word 'THE' is scaled down and nested between larger words
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A highly decorative, interlocking display face paired with a cleaner, more legible geometric sans for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the Art Deco era essence

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-fashion portrait of a woman with a black bob haircut, wearing an intricate pearl headpiece and a white feather boa with pink-tipped feathers. She is reclining on a dark green velvet chaise longue. The background is solid black. Surround the scene with a complex, multi-layered neon pink Art Deco geometric frame featuring stepped corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply custom ultra-condensed Art Deco lettering at the top, using white with a subtle pink outer glow. Nest smaller words within the larger ones. Add a simpler geometric sans-serif title at the bottom with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the border neon pink and multi-lined?
Is the headpiece made of pearls and crystals?
Is the top text ultra-condensed and interlocking?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the pink glow on the border
Degree of letter nesting in the display text
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
Exact brand logos or artist signatures

mustAchieve: Sharp, clean vector lines for the border
Soft, realistic texture for the feathers and velvet
avoid: Clashing warm tones (keep to cool pinks/greens)
Generic modern sans-serif fonts without Deco styling

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the pink border does not obscure the subject's face.
Verify the text is legible despite the condensed style.
Check that the feather textures look soft and high-resolution.
Confirm the Art Deco motifs are consistent in all four corners.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a 1920s fashion portrait with a neon-lit Art Deco geometric frame and ultra-condensed interlocking typography.
